approach: Matching decompilation: C++ compiled with the original VC++ .NET 2003 compiler, each function verified byte-exact or by differential emulation against the original
notes: All 3,270 game functions (static CRT excluded) have compilable source, organised as one .cpp per original translation unit. 2,183 are byte-identical to the original (66.8% of functions, 27.3% of code size); the rest are tested for equivalence by running the original and our code on the same inputs under emulation. Hybrid builds splice our non-identical functions into the original exe to playtest them.
help: Matching the remaining equivalent functions byte-exact (cl 13.10 codegen: register allocation, scheduling, frame layout)
